WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.modindex) as overall_modindex
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
telescope_weather_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshiftdeg
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM telescope_weather_groups
  WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT overall_modindex FROM overall_avg)
)
SELECT 
  fg.weathprofile,
  AVG(fg.avg_modindex) as weather_avg_modindex,
  AVG(fg.avg_phaseshiftdeg) as weather_avg_phaseshiftdeg,
  AVG(fg.avg_modindex) - (SELECT overall_modindex FROM overall_avg) as above_overall
FROM filtered_groups fg
GROUP BY fg.weathprofile
ORDER BY fg.weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: "Signals that don't match" are dropped via INNER JOIN, excluding any signal lacking a corresponding telescope or observatory record.
